tool.name: nf-core adapterremoval
tool.description: Trim sequencing adapters and collapse overlapping reads
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ AdapterRemoval \\ --file1 ${reads} \\ ${args} \\ ${list} \\ --basename ${prefix} \\ --threads ${task.cpus} \\ --seed 42 \\ --gzip
ensure_fastq() { if [ -f "\${1}" ]; then mv "\${1}" "\${1::-3}.fastq.gz" fi
}
ensure_fastq '${prefix}.truncated.gz' ensure_fastq '${prefix}.discarded.gz'
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": adapterremoval: \$(AdapterRemoval --version 2>&1 | sed -e "s/AdapterRemoval ver. //g") END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Trim sequencing adapters and collapse overlapping reads
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: adapterremoval Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/adapterremoval ]]>
